limits.all_before_and_after: Report all roles/styles/streams, paired losses and gains, joint3role and6role results, and before-correct→after-wrong without dropping any baseline failures.
limits.same_input_contrasts: At each fixed tail kind/count compare decay/delta/both with none under each reader; compare oracle with full within each gate mode. Compare related vs unrelated tail at matched token/record lengths.
limits.scope: Fresh generated streams relative to the recorded local input inventory, frozen model mechanism diagnostic. No architecture confirmation, significance threshold, new training or scaleup trigger.
limits.encoding_scope: Prefix-evidence encoding is fixed. Related-tail current answers require newly encoded tail evidence and are reported as update positive controls; they do not enjoy fixed-evidence encoding.
limits.remaining_limits: Tail gates can change subsequent hidden/Query/tail-KV/convolution states. Prefix KV equality does not uniquely localize an error to matrix storage, separate erase from insertion, or prove a learned semantic update rule. Before/after differences alone also change distance/position; gate contrasts keep actual tail tokens and positions fixed.
